blocks.text: GEORGE TOWN – Malaysians in the northern states woke to a wet morning on Oct 26, with satellite imagery showing heavy cloud cover over all of Penang and much of Kedah and Perlis. It had been raining in the states since about 10pm on the night of Oct 25, and in Kedah, several rivers were at alert or danger levels as of 5am on Oct 26. According to the Public InfoBanjir portal, the water level at Kampung Padang Pasir in Kubang Pasu district, near Changlun, reached 21.814m, exceeding the danger level of 21.6m and continuing to rise.
